remarks: Introducing 10 NOBLE STREET! A stunning 5-bedroom, 2-bathroom raised ranch in the heart of Stamford's desirable Waterside Neighborhood. This beautifully maintained home has plenty of ample space for living and entertaining. This turnkey property is move-in ready! Enjoy the perfect blend of indoor and outdoor living with a gorgeous in-ground pool and patio, ideal for hosting gatherings and soaking up the sun. Located adjacent to the Cohen Sound Waters Harbor Center and Boccuzzi Park, this home presents a tranquil setting with plenty of nearby amenities. Conveniently situated just moments from the Stamford Train Station, you'll enjoy easy and quick access to New York City. Additionally, enjoy the Downtown Stamford's vibrant scene, featuring a diverse range of restaurants, shops, and cultural attractions, which is just a short distance away. Don't miss out on this exceptional opportunity to own a piece of Stamford's up-and-coming Waterside Neighborhood. Schedule a viewing today and make 10 Noble Street your dream home!"
